newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine beef exports to United States in August.
newsitem.headline: Argentine beef exports to United States in August.

text.p: Argentine exporters will make their first shipment of beef to the United States August 25 following U.S. sanitary approval of a 20,000-tonne export quota, Economy Minister Roque Fernandez said Friday.
"The first exports of Argentine beef to the United States leave on August 25," Fernandez said, quoted by the state-controlled Telam news agency.
The United States finally granted sanitary approval for an import quota in June, ending a 67-year ban on beef shipments from Argentina.

Argentina was barred for decades from major world beef markets due to its problems with foot-and-mouth disease, but it was officially declared free of the disease by the International Epizootic Office in Paris in May.
